title: Eleven years
logline: Eleven. The corn on newsprint: the anniversary strip runs in a newspaper for the first time. He eats the corn on page fourteen.

panels.composition: The garage. The Newport weekly spread on the table as a placemat. The corn on it, on page fourteen, on last week's strip. WOOD. BARNABY.

image.prompt: a man at a drafting table eating corn from a tray set directly on a newspaper's comics page, a dog under the table, muddy flats

panels.composition: The corn tray on the strip. Grease coming through the newsprint onto last Tuesday's panel 3.

image.prompt: close-up of a paper tray of corn on a newspaper comic strip, grease soaking through onto a panel

balloons.text: Eleven years. I'm eating off myself. That's either arrival or the opposite.

image.prompt: a man speaking to a dog while eating corn off a newspaper

panels.composition: Alone at the long surface. The paper. The corn. #1 on the wall, above, older than the newsprint.
